title: Cipher Alignment
statementMarkdown:
An ancient alignment plate bears the cipher **MCMXCIV**. The console decodes additive letters (M, C, X, I) forward, while subtractive pairs (CM, XC, IV) reduce.

**Transmit the decimal value the cipher aligns to.**
hints: Break it apart: M + CM + XC + IV.
Each subtractive pair contributes 90 or 90… decode CM = 900 and XC = 90 carefully.
